notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.

connection.mayBeRemoved: The hub has refused this browser several times for over a minute. It may have been removed from the hub.
connection.outOfTouch: Out of touch with the hub: what you see may be out of date, and nothing can be changed until it is back.

failure.refused: The hub did not accept this browser. It may be busy, or this browser may have been removed.
failure.notOurHub: Something answered with a key that is not this hub's.
failure.protocol: The hub's answer could not be read.
failure.timeout: The hub did not answer in time.
failure.keyFailed: This browser's key could not be used.
failure.closed: The connection to the hub dropped.

link.title: Link this browser
link.intro: This browser is not linked to the hub yet. On the hub computer, run hsn open to open the app there, or enter a code the hub or a linked device gave you.
link.codeHint: Twelve letters and digits, like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN.
link.removed: This browser was removed from the hub, so it can no longer see or change anything.
link.noStorage: This browser cannot keep a key safely (it may be in private browsing, or its storage is turned off), so it cannot be linked.
link.fromConsole: Run hsn open on the hub computer again for a new code.

failure.unreachable: The hub cannot be reached from this browser.
failure.refused: The hub does not know this code: it may have been used, have expired, or be mistyped.
failure.wrongHub: This is not the hub that made the code, so nothing was sent to it.
failure.notAccepted: The hub did not accept the code. It may be mistyped, used or expired.
failure.protocol: The hub's answer could not be read.
failure.timeout: The hub did not answer in time.
failure.noWebCrypto: This browser cannot make a key that stays secret, so it cannot be linked.
failure.extractable: This browser cannot make a key that stays secret, so it cannot be linked.
failure.failed: This browser could not make its key.
failure.storage: This browser could not keep its key, so it is not linked.
failure.unreadable: The address held a code that could not be read. Ask for a new one.
failure.badCode: That code is not right: check it and type it again.
failure.needsName: The hub needs your name to link this browser.

link.askName: This code makes you a new person of the house. What is your name?

errors.unauthorized: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unauthorizedDevices_one: You are not allowed to manage {{devices}}, so nothing was changed.
errors.unauthorizedDevices_other: You are not allowed to manage {{devices}}, so nothing was changed.
errors.needsConfirmation: Some sensors need your confirmation first.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this meanwhile. It is shown as it is now.
errors.seqTooLow: The hub did not take this request. Try again.

invalid.format: That is not in a form the hub accepts.
invalid.range: That value is out of range.
invalid.unknownReference: Something it names no longer exists.
invalid.inUse: Schedules still use this. Change them first.
invalid.lastManager: Someone must keep the permission to manage people.
invalid.tooOld: Only devices linked in the last 30 days can go with it.
invalid.noDevicesRequired: A backup can be restored only on a hub with no devices.
invalid.noAnswer: The board did not answer. Check its cable and try again.
invalid.noGateway: No gateway is connected. Plug one in first.
invalid.badFile: That file is not a backup or release the hub can read.
invalid.badSignature: That release is not signed by a key this hub trusts.
invalid.wrongSystem: That release is for another kind of computer.
invalid.notNewer: That release is not newer than the hub's own version.
invalid.full: There is not enough room on the hub's disk for the update.

busy.siteMove: The site is moving to new radio settings. Wait until that is done.
busy.updateSwitch: The hub is switching to an update. Wait a moment.
busy.provisioning: A board is being added. Wait until that is done.
busy.countdown: A countdown is running. Wait until it has ended.
busy.alarm: The alarm is sounding. Wait until it has ended.
busy.upload: A file is already being sent.

errors.consoleOnly: Only the browser on the hub computer can do this.
errors.unavailable: The hub cannot save changes at the moment. Its computer says why.
errors.protoUnsupported: This app and the hub do not speak the same version.
errors.notBuilt: The hub cannot do this yet.

local.offline: Not connected to the hub, so nothing was sent. Try again when it is back.
local.lost: The connection dropped before the hub answered. Try again.
local.badReply: The hub's answer could not be read.
local.storage: This browser could not save its request number, so nothing was sent.
local.removed: This browser was removed from the hub.
local.notLinked: This browser is not linked to the hub.
local.tabClosed: The tab that was talking to the hub closed before it answered, so it is not known whether the hub did it.
local.unconfirmed: The hub did not confirm this. The screen now shows the house as the hub reports it: check whether it was done.

time.untrusted: The hub's clock is not set, so times are approximate.

home.unknownMode: a mode this browser does not know yet
home.modesUnknown: The hub has not told this browser which modes it has, so they cannot be shown here yet.
home.waiting_one: {{sensors}} will arm when its door closes.
home.waiting_other: {{sensors}} will arm when their doors close.

confirm.title: Confirm first
confirm.openDoors: Doors open now: {{sensors}}. Each will arm when its door closes.
confirm.lowBattery: Low battery: {{sensors}}. They may stop working soon.

banner.alarmContinues: Your sensors are disarmed, but the alarm continues: {{sensors}} cannot be disarmed by you.

added.gateway: Gateway {{name}} was added on its own.
added.sensor: Sensor {{name}} was added. It is disarmed until the next switch to a mode that holds it.

state.leftBehind: Left behind by a site move

usb.title: Add a board over USB
usb.intro: Plug a sensor, siren or gateway into this computer with its USB cable, then look again.
usb.noIdentity: The board has not said what it is yet.
usb.nameHint: 1 to 64 characters, no spaces, like front-door.
usb.nameError: Use 1 to 64 characters with no spaces.

setup.intro: Set up the hub in four steps. Each is saved as soon as it is done.
setup.consoleOnly: Setup is done in the browser on the hub computer.

person.title: 1. Your name
person.intro: The first person of the house. Others are added later.
person.label: Your name
person.error: Use 1 to 64 characters, without control characters.

site.title: 2. Radio
site.surveyHint: The hub listens on each channel through the first gateway, which takes about six minutes. A gateway must be connected.
site.rateHint: Lower is slower and reaches further; higher is faster and shorter. Fixed once the first device is paired.

wifi.title: 3. Wi-Fi for devices
wifi.intro: Sirens and Wi-Fi gateways join this network. The hub keeps the password and gives it only to the boards you add; it is entered here, on the hub computer, so it does not cross the home network.

devices.title: 4. Devices
devices.intro: Plug the gateway in first: it is added on its own. Then add sensors and sirens over USB and name them.

editing.badName: Use 1 to 64 characters, without control characters.
editing.conflict: Someone changed this while you were editing, so your change was not saved.

groups.intro: A group is a set of sensors and the sirens they sound. A sensor may be in several groups. A sensor in no group sounds every siren.
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteQuestion: Delete the group {{name}}? Its sensors stay as they are, and modes that hold it lose it.
groups.atLeastOneSiren: Choose at least one siren, or Every siren.

modes.intro: A mode is a set of groups: switching to it arms their sensors and disarms the others. Away and Disarmed are fixed.
modes.name: Mode name
modes.noGroups: There are no groups yet: make one first.
modes.fixed: A fixed mode: it cannot be changed or deleted.
modes.deleteCurrentQuestion: {{name}} is the current mode. Delete it? The house stays armed as it is, in no mode.

schedules.intro: Each entry does one thing at one time, in the hub's time zone ({{zone}}). A missed entry is skipped, never run late.
schedules.clockWaits: The hub's clock is not set: no entry runs until it is.
schedules.name: Entry name

noTargets.mode: No modes are known to this browser yet.

missedWhy.clockNotSet: the hub's clock was not set
missedWhy.clockStepped: the computer's clock jumped forward over it

history.intro: What the hub recorded that you may see, newest first.

decision.move_unconfirmed: Device has not confirmed the site move
decision.waits_for_door_to_close: Waits for its door to close
decision.schedule_held_back: Schedule entry held back during the alarm
decision.backup_folder_on_data_disk: Backup folder on the hub's own disk
decision.backup_no_folder: No backup folder chosen: nothing is backed up

event.data_folder_was_open: The data folder was open when the hub started

notifications.categoriesIntro: Turn off what you do not want told on this browser. Alarms, countdowns, tampering and the other urgent notices are always told.
notifications.closedTab: A closed tab is told nothing: keep this page open, or use the phone app when it comes.
notifications.browserNone: This browser cannot show its own notices.
notifications.browserOn: This browser shows its own notice for urgent notifications while this page is open.
notifications.browserDenied: This browser was told not to show notices for this page. Its site settings can allow them.

category.localAlarm: A sensor sounded its own alarm
category.scheduleMissedOrHeldBack: A schedule entry missed or held back
category.newClient: A new device linked to your account
category.stateUnexpected: A door or cover not as expected

people.userManagementOff: Off: everyone may do everything, and permissions are not shown.
people.userManagementOn: On: each person may do what their permissions allow.
people.noAccess: No access yet: give this person permissions below.
people.name: Name
people.removeQuestion: Remove {{name}}? Their devices are removed too and can no longer see or change anything. Their history stays.
people.added: {{name}} was added. Link a device for them next.
people.removeClientQuestion_one: Remove {{name}}, and the {{count}} device ticked above that it linked? They can no longer see or change anything.
people.removeClientQuestion_other: Remove {{name}}, and the {{count}} devices ticked above that it linked? They can no longer see or change anything.
people.removeSelfQuestion: Remove this browser? It will no longer see or change anything until it is linked again.
people.alsoTitle: Devices {{name}} linked in the last 30 days, removed with it unless unticked:

linkDevice.intro: Make a code for another device. It works once, links at once, and expires.
linkDevice.personNameHint: Optional: they can give it themselves.

forms.url: A link address, for a browser here
forms.qr: A QR code, for a phone

linkDevice.invite: For someone not here now (valid 24 hours)
linkDevice.urlHow: Open this address in the other browser on the home network:
linkDevice.codeHow: Type this code on the other device:
linkDevice.once: Whoever uses it first is linked; if that was not the person it was for, they will find it refused.
linkDevice.qrHow: Scan this with the other device's camera:
linkDevice.qrLabel: The QR code that links the other device

deviceDetail.unknown: This device is not known to this browser.
deviceDetail.keepEmpty: Leave a field empty to keep it as it is.
deviceDetail.keepEmptyDefault: Leave empty for the hub's usual length.
deviceDetail.badSetting: Use whole numbers in the ranges shown, and change at least one.
deviceDetail.settingsSaved: Saved, as settings version {{version}}. The device takes them at its next contact.
deviceDetail.name: Device name
deviceDetail.removeQuestion: Remove {{name}}? It must be paired again to come back.
deviceDetail.countdownHint: 0 to 255: how long after the door opens before the alarm.
deviceDetail.heartbeatHint: 1 to 255: 12 is every 3 minutes, the usual.
deviceDetail.linkCheckHint: 1 to 255: ask for a reply on every Nth heartbeat; 5 is the usual.
deviceDetail.learnHint: A number, or learn to let the hub find it.
deviceDetail.testIntro: The siren sounds for real, for the time below.
deviceDetail.testQuestion: Sound the siren now? Everyone nearby will hear it.

site.timingsNow: Now: a countdown of {{countdown}} s; sirens stop by themselves after {{autoStop}} s.
site.radioFixed: Fixed once the first device is paired; after that, move the site below.
site.moveIntro: Moves every device to a new channel or rate. Each device confirms in turn; the hub switches when they all have.
site.forceQuestion: Switch now? {{left}} devices have not confirmed and will be left behind until paired again.
site.retention: Routine records are kept {{routine}} days, events {{events}} days.
site.retentionGuard: Whatever is set here, the hub shortens history by size if its database grows too large.

backup.noFolder: No backup folder is chosen yet, so no backup is written.
backup.schedule: Daily at {{hour}}:00; the newest {{keep}} are kept.
backup.due: Changes since the newest backup are not in any backup yet.
backup.folderLabel: Backup folder on the hub computer
backup.folderHint: Only the hub computer's browser can set it.
backup.started: A backup was started; its result shows here when it is done.
backup.exportIntro: A copy saved by this browser, never written on the hub. Choose which:
backup.exported: Exported: the browser saved the backup.

downloadFault.gap: The file arrived incomplete. Try again.
downloadFault.hash: The file arrived damaged. Try again.
downloadFault.badChunk: The file arrived damaged. Try again.
downloadFault.stalled: The file stopped arriving. Try again.
downloadFault.io: The hub could not make the file. Try again; if it fails again, the hub computer's console says why.
downloadFault.stopping: The hub stopped before the file was finished. Try again when it is back.

backup.restoreIntro: On a new hub with no devices, from the hub computer: choose a backup file. A phone that holds the backup key unlocks it (from the phone app's arrival).
backup.fileFrom: This backup is of hub {{identity}}, made {{made}}.
backup.peopleAge: Its people and permissions are from {{time}}: anyone removed since then can use the hub again.
backup.oldHubOff: Keep the old hub switched off: two hubs with the same keys would both command the sirens.
backup.goOn: Go on: show the restore code
backup.scanWithPhone: Scan this with a phone that holds the backup key:
backup.qrLabel: The QR code that unlocks the restore
backup.exportBackupIs: A backup of the settings is sealed: it can be opened only with the backup key the phones hold, and can be restored.
backup.exportHistoryIs: The history is a readable file of every record (JSON Lines). It holds no keys, is not encrypted, and cannot be restored: keep it where only you can read it.
backup.exportedHistory: Exported: the browser saved the history file. It is not encrypted.
backup.historyNotBackup: This is a history export, not a backup: choose a backup file.
backup.damaged: The backup file is damaged or incomplete; choose another.

restoreResult.wrongKey: This key does not open that backup.
restoreResult.expired: The restore code has expired: start again on the hub computer.
restoreResult.busy: The hub is busy: try again in a moment.

updates.switching: The hub is switching to the update now.

last.rolledBack: The last update failed and was undone.

updates.approveQuestion: Switch to version {{version}}? The hub restarts when no countdown, alarm or site move runs.
updates.uploadIntro: From the hub computer: a release file. The hub checks its signature and version.

status.shortened: History was shortened to keep the database within its size.
status.missing: Records from {{time}} may be missing after a restart.

hubNotice.updateStaged: An update is ready: someone who manages the system can approve it on the Updates screen.
hubNotice.updateRefused: An update was refused: see the Updates screen.
hubNotice.updateSwitching: The hub is switching to an update and will be back in a moment.
hubNotice.backup: A backup finished: see the Backup screen for its result.
hubNotice.databaseFailing: The hub cannot save changes at the moment, so changes are refused; what you see still updates. Its computer says why.
hubNotice.databaseRecovered: The hub can save changes again.
hubNotice.databaseSize: The hub's records are near their size limit: the oldest history will be shortened.
hubNotice.historyShortened: History was shortened to keep the hub's records within their size.
